name: aws-durable-execution-sdk-js-insight-vscode
description: Query AWS Durable Execution Workflow Insight data from CloudWatch Logs using plain English.

workflowInsight.region.description: AWS region of the CloudWatch log group (e.g. us-east-1). Falls back to AWS_REGION.

workflowInsight.logGroupName.description: CloudWatch log group that receives Workflow Insight records. With the default LambdaLogExporter this is the function's own log group, e.g. /aws/lambda/my-durable-fn. Comma-separate multiple groups.

enumDescriptions: Dedicated log group via CloudWatchLogsExporter — records are raw JSON, fields queryable directly
Function's own log group via LambdaLogExporter — records nested in Lambda JSON envelope (message field)
DynamoDB table via DynamoDBExporter — records queryable via PartiQL
Aurora PostgreSQL/MySQL via AuroraExporter — full SQL with GROUP BY, JOIN, aggregations
workflowInsight.destinationType.description: Where and how records are stored. Determines query engine and format.

workflowInsight.dynamodbTableName.description: DynamoDB table name (required when destinationType is 'dynamodb').

workflowInsight.auroraResourceArn.description: Aurora cluster ARN (required when destinationType is 'aurora').

workflowInsight.auroraSecretArn.description: Secrets Manager ARN for Aurora Data API auth (required when destinationType is 'aurora').

workflowInsight.auroraTable.description: Aurora table name containing insight records.

workflowInsight.awsProfile.description: Named AWS profile to use. Leave empty to use the default credential provider chain (env, SSO, default profile).

enumDescriptions: Amazon Bedrock (Converse API) — requires AWS credentials and model access
GitHub Copilot (VS Code Language Model API) — requires Copilot subscription
Local LLM (Qwen2.5-Coder-3B) — runs offline, downloads model on first use (~2.2 GB)
workflowInsight.llmProvider.description: Which LLM to use for converting questions to queries.

workflowInsight.bedrockModelId.description: Amazon Bedrock model id (or inference profile id) used to convert English to a Logs Insights query.

scripts.build: cd webview-ui && npm run build && cd .. && node esbuild.mjs
